judge_notes: All three candidates returned zero assays. This is correct: the study uses only ex vivo work, namely whole-cell patch-clamp electrophysiology and Fura-2 AM calcium imaging in acute hippocampal slices. The rubric excludes both methods.
25CN-NBOH was applied only by bath to brain slices. It was never given to living animals, and no behavioural test was run. The study therefore has no scorable behavioural assays under the rubric.

The dosing entry is kept for descriptive completeness. Its route is 'other' (bath application in vitro) and its vehicle is 'other' (ACSF), and no mg/kg conversion is possible. Deepseek4 left dosing empty; qwen listed the bath concentration.
Identity fields follow the qwen and deepseek4 candidates and match the paper: the DOI appears in the markdown, and NMRI mice of both sexes were used at P14-30. The gemma4 candidate gave no metadata.
Enrichment_housing is set to not_reported with low confidence because the paper never mentions home-cage enrichment.
